home_tagline: Write content in YAML, publish with Rust
what_is_dx5_text: dx5 is a file‑based CMS written in Rust. No database, no admin panel – just plain YAML files, Markdown, and powerful templating with Tera.
feature_files_text: Every post, code snippet, or page is a simple YAML file. Version control friendly, easy to backup.
feature_fields_text: Define your own field types in dx5.fields.toml. Reusable, schema‑validated blocks.
feature_i18n_text: Built‑in support for multiple languages. Translate your entire site with JSON files.
